text:
nina: Quick sync  we're bringing up q8b-int4 for multi-turn code and long-context summaries. I want a focused curation pass that prioritizes semantic regressions (not just token diffs).
ash: Good call. How do you want to measure semantic regressions?
nina: Add a semantic_change_score using embedding cosine + normalized edit heuristics. Anything with score > 0.35 gets flagged. Also keep token-overlap and BLEU as secondary checks.
cory: I can generate a stratified sample: 1200 unique prompts biased to multi-turn (400), code (300), long-summary (300), and high-traffic intents (200). Dedupe exact tokens first, then cluster near-dupes at 94%.
nina: Perfect. Keep a manifest of collapsed clusters for audit. Do not feed representatives that show paraphrase ambiguity without a reviewer check.
labeler-ops-bot: @cory created campaign semprobe-q8b-int4 (1200 tasks) -> group "sem-smoke"; tags_required=[severity,regression_type,semantic_score,notes]; ETA=48h.
ash: Metadata we want per row: sample_id,prompt_hash,intent,length_bucket,model_variant,quant_profile,decode,seed,semantic_change_score,token_overlap,bleu_delta,flag_reason. CSV header please.
cory: Will output CSV to s3://redwood-qa/semprobe/q8b/semprobe_batch1.csv with that header. Also include baseline output and candidate output blobs in s3 for any flagged sample.
nina: Label instructions: severity in [none/minor/major/critical], regression_type [semantic_hallucination,context_loss,formatting,code-bug,other]. For ambiguous semantic cases labelers can mark "requires_adjudication". First 250 labeled by seniors.
ash: Decision rule: pause canary if semantic_regression_rate >3% overall OR any critical semantic_hallucination on golden anchors. Also require per-intent check: if an intent exceeds 7% semantic_regressions, target that intent for fp16 fallback.
nina: Add an auto-prioritizer: rank flagged samples by semantic_score * (1 + severity_prior) so labelers see highest-risk first.
cory: I'll add a small prefilter script and run locally; pseudo:
```
score = semantic_change(emb_baseline, emb_candidate) + 0.5*edit_dist_norm
if score > 0.35:
  flag(sample_id, reason="semantic")
elif token_overlap < 0.65 and bleu_delta < -0.1:
  flag(sample_id, reason="surface")
```
labeler-ops-bot: Campaign semprobe-q8b-int4 updated: reviewers=senior(3)/rotating(5), auto-tags=[semantic_flag,surface_flag], priority=high.
nina: Thanks. Keep all updates short in this thread. I'll post the harness summary (semantic_regression_rate, severity_breakdown, per-intent hotspots) after 250 senior labels land. :eyes:
